gaps.sentence: The road was closed because of ___ (VISIBLE) conditions.
gaps.hint: noun phrase: how far you can see
gaps.explanation: 'Visibility' = the distance you can see; paired with 'poor'.

gaps.sentence: The problem was ___ (SIMPLE) a matter of bad timing.
gaps.explanation: 'Simply a matter of' = only a matter of.

gaps.sentence: She gave a very ___ (CONFUSE) explanation of the rules.
gaps.explanation: 'Confusing' describes something that causes confusion; 'confused' describes the person affected.

gaps.sentence: His sudden ___ (RESIGN) surprised everyone in the department.
gaps.hint: noun: act of leaving a job

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.
The government made a formal ___ (DECLARE) of intent to invest in rail.
gaps.explanation: 'A formal declaration' — the noun follows the adjective.
